verses.text: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was among the captives by the River Chebar: the heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.display_text: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was among the captives by the River Chebar: the heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.

verses.text: On the fifth of the month—this was the fifth year of King Jehoiakim’s captivity—
verses.display_text: On the fifth of the month—this was the fifth year of King Jehoiakim’s captivity—

verses.text: the Lord’s word came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the Lord’s hand came upon me,
verses.display_text: the Lord’s word came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the Lord’s hand came upon me,

verses.text: and I looked, and behold, a sweeping wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud was within it, with brightness around it and fire flashing like lightning; within it was something like the appearance of electrum, within the fire, and brightness within it.
verses.display_text: and I looked, and behold, a sweeping wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud was within it, with brightness around it and fire flashing like lightning; within it was something like the appearance of electrum, within the fire, and brightness within it.

verses.text: And within it was something like a likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: a human likeness was upon them,
verses.display_text: And within it was something like a likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: a human likeness was upon them,

verses.text: and each had four faces, and each had four wings.
verses.display_text: and each had four faces, and each had four wings.

verses.text: Their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, with sparks like flashing bronze; and their wings were light.
verses.display_text: Their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, with sparks like flashing bronze; and their wings were light.

verses.text: A human hand was beneath their wings on their four sides; and the faces of all four of them
verses.display_text: A human hand was beneath their wings on their four sides; and the faces of all four of them

verses.text: did not turn as they walked; each went straight ahead.
verses.display_text: did not turn as they walked; each went straight ahead.

verses.text: The likeness of their faces was a human face and a lion’s face on the right for all four, and a calf’s face on the left for all four, and an eagle’s face for all four.
verses.display_text: The likeness of their faces was a human face and a lion’s face on the right for all four, and a calf’s face on the left for all four, and an eagle’s face for all four.

verses.text: The wings of all four were stretched out above; each had two joined to one another, and two covered the top of their bodies.
verses.display_text: The wings of all four were stretched out above; each had two joined to one another, and two covered the top of their bodies.

verses.text: Each went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit was going, they went and did not turn.
verses.display_text: Each went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit was going, they went and did not turn.

verses.text: And amid the living creatures was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of torches whirling among the living creatures, and brightness of the fire; lightning came out of the fire.
verses.display_text: And amid the living creatures was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of torches whirling among the living creatures, and brightness of the fire; lightning came out of the fire.

verses.text: I looked, and behold, one wheel was on the earth adjoining the four living creatures;
verses.display_text: I looked, and behold, one wheel was on the earth adjoining the four living creatures;

verses.text: the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of tharsis, and all four had one likeness; their workmanship was as though a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.display_text: the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of tharsis, and all four had one likeness; their workmanship was as though a wheel were within a wheel.

verses.text: They went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went,
verses.display_text: They went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went,

verses.text: nor did their backs; they were tall, and I saw them. The backs of all four were full of eyes all around.
verses.display_text: nor did their backs; they were tall, and I saw them. The backs of all four were full of eyes all around.

verses.text: When the living creatures went, the wheels moved beside them; when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.
verses.display_text: When the living creatures went, the wheels moved beside them; when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.

verses.text: Wherever the cloud was, there was the spirit for movement; the living creatures and the wheels went and rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.display_text: Wherever the cloud was, there was the spirit for movement; the living creatures and the wheels went and rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.

verses.text: When they went, these went; when they stood, these stood; when they rose from the earth, these rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.display_text: When they went, these went; when they stood, these stood; when they rose from the earth, these rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.

verses.text: Above the living creatures’ heads was a likeness as of a firmament, like the appearance of crystal, stretched out above their wings;
verses.display_text: Above the living creatures’ heads was a likeness as of a firmament, like the appearance of crystal, stretched out above their wings;

verses.text: and beneath the firmament their wings were stretched out, fluttering one toward another; each had two joined together, covering their bodies.
verses.display_text: and beneath the firmament their wings were stretched out, fluttering one toward another; each had two joined together, covering their bodies.

verses.text: As they went, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of much water; when they stood, their wings came to rest.
verses.display_text: As they went, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of much water; when they stood, their wings came to rest.

verses.text: And behold, a voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads.
verses.display_text: And behold, a voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads.

verses.text: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne upon it; and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the form of a human being.
verses.display_text: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne upon it; and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the form of a human being.

verses.text: I saw something like the sight of electrum from the appearance of a waist upward; and from the appearance of a waist down below I saw something like the appearance of fire, with its brightness all around.
verses.display_text: I saw something like the sight of electrum from the appearance of a waist upward; and from the appearance of a waist down below I saw something like the appearance of fire, with its brightness all around.

verses.text: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud on a rainy day, so was the arrangement of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the Lord’s glory. I saw it, and I fall upon my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking.
verses.display_text: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud on a rainy day, so was the arrangement of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the Lord’s glory. I saw it, and I fall upon my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking.

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”

verses.text: A spirit came upon me, took me up, raised me, and set me on my feet; I heard Him speaking to me,
verses.display_text: A spirit came upon me, took me up, raised me, and set me on my feet; I heard Him speaking to me,

verses.text: and He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you out to the house of Israel, those who embitter Me, who have embittered Me, they and their fathers, until this present day,
verses.display_text: and He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you out to the house of Israel, those who embitter Me, who have embittered Me, they and their fathers, until this present day,

verses.text: and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord.’
verses.display_text: and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord.’

verses.text: If indeed they listen or are terrified—for it is an embittering house—they will know that you are a prophet among them.
verses.display_text: If indeed they listen or are terrified—for it is an embittering house—they will know that you are a prophet among them.

verses.text: And you, son of man, do not fear them or be shaken before their faces, because they will rage and gather against you all around, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not fear their words or be shaken before their faces, for it is an embittering house.
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, do not fear them or be shaken before their faces, because they will rage and gather against you all around, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not fear their words or be shaken before their faces, for it is an embittering house.

verses.text: You will speak My words to them, if indeed they listen or are terrified, for it is an embittering house.
verses.display_text: You will speak My words to them, if indeed they listen or are terrified, for it is an embittering house.

verses.text: And you, son of man, hear the One speaking to you. Do not become embittering like the embittering house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I give you.”
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, hear the One speaking to you. Do not become embittering like the embittering house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I give you.”

verses.text: I looked, and behold, a hand was stretched toward me, and in it was a scroll of a book;
verses.display_text: I looked, and behold, a hand was stretched toward me, and in it was a scroll of a book;

verses.text: and He unrolled it before me. It had writing on the back and the front, and upon it were written a lament, a song and woe.
verses.display_text: and He unrolled it before me. It had writing on the back and the front, and upon it were written a lament, a song and woe.

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll, then go and speak to the sons of Israel.”
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll, then go and speak to the sons of Israel.”

verses.text: I opened my mouth wide, and He fed me the scroll.
verses.display_text: I opened my mouth wide, and He fed me the scroll.

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, your mouth will eat, and your belly will be filled with this scroll that has been given to you.” I ate it, and in my mouth it became like sweet honey.
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, your mouth will eat, and your belly will be filled with this scroll that has been given to you.” I ate it, and in my mouth it became like sweet honey.

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the house of Israel, and speak My words to them;
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the house of Israel, and speak My words to them;

verses.text: for you are not sent out to a people of deep speech and heavy tongue, but to the house of Israel,
verses.display_text: for you are not sent out to a people of deep speech and heavy tongue, but to the house of Israel,

verses.text: nor to many peoples of foreign speech or foreign tongues, nor those strong in tongue whose words you will not understand. If I had sent you to such people, they would have listened to you.
verses.display_text: nor to many peoples of foreign speech or foreign tongues, nor those strong in tongue whose words you will not understand. If I had sent you to such people, they would have listened to you.

verses.text: But the house of Israel certainly will not be willing to listen to you, because they do not wish to listen to Me; the entire house of Israel is contentious and hard-hearted.
verses.display_text: But the house of Israel certainly will not be willing to listen to you, because they do not wish to listen to Me; the entire house of Israel is contentious and hard-hearted.

verses.text: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen your contention against their contention,
verses.display_text: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen your contention against their contention,

verses.text: and it will always be stronger than rock. Do not fear them or be terrified before their faces, for it is an embittering house.”
verses.display_text: and it will always be stronger than rock. Do not fear them or be terrified before their faces, for it is an embittering house.”

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears,
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears,

verses.text: and go, enter the captivity, to the sons of your people; you will speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord,’ if indeed they listen, if indeed they yield.”
verses.display_text: and go, enter the captivity, to the sons of your people; you will speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord,’ if indeed they listen, if indeed they yield.”

verses.text: A spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great shaking: “Blessed be the Lord’s glory from His place!”
verses.display_text: A spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great shaking: “Blessed be the Lord’s glory from His place!”

verses.text: I saw the sound of the living creatures’ wings fluttering one toward another, and the sound of the wheels adjoining them, and the sound of the shaking.
verses.display_text: I saw the sound of the living creatures’ wings fluttering one toward another, and the sound of the wheels adjoining them, and the sound of the shaking.

verses.text: The spirit raised me and took me up. I went, impelled by my spirit, and the Lord’s hand came strongly upon me.
verses.display_text: The spirit raised me and took me up. I went, impelled by my spirit, and the Lord’s hand came strongly upon me.

verses.text: I entered the captivity aloft and went around those dwelling by the River Chebar, those who were there; I sat there seven days, living among them.
verses.display_text: I entered the captivity aloft and went around those dwelling by the River Chebar, those who were there; I sat there seven days, living among them.

verses.text: After the seven days, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: After the seven days, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel. You will hear a word from My mouth and convey My warning to them.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel. You will hear a word from My mouth and convey My warning to them.

verses.text: When I say to the lawless person, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not warn him or speak to warn the lawless person to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless person will die in his injustice; but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.display_text: When I say to the lawless person, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not warn him or speak to warn the lawless person to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless person will die in his injustice; but I will require his blood from your hand.

verses.text: But if you warn the lawless person and he does not turn from his lawlessness and his way, that lawless person will die in his injustice, while you will rescue your life.
verses.display_text: But if you warn the lawless person and he does not turn from his lawlessness and his way, that lawless person will die in his injustice, while you will rescue your life.

verses.text: When a righteous person turns from his righteous deeds and commits a transgression, and I place torment before his face, he will die because you did not warn him. He will die in his sins, because the righteous deeds he did certainly will not be remembered, and I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.display_text: When a righteous person turns from his righteous deeds and commits a transgression, and I place torment before his face, he will die because you did not warn him. He will die in his sins, because the righteous deeds he did certainly will not be remembered, and I will require his blood from your hand.

verses.text: But if you warn the righteous person not to sin, and he does not sin, the righteous person will surely live because you warned him; and you will rescue your own life.”
verses.display_text: But if you warn the righteous person not to sin, and he does not sin, the righteous person will surely live because you warned him; and you will rescue your own life.”

verses.text: The Lord’s hand came upon me, and He said to me, “Rise and go out to the plain, and you will be spoken to there.”
verses.display_text: The Lord’s hand came upon me, and He said to me, “Rise and go out to the plain, and you will be spoken to there.”

verses.text: I rose and went out to the plain, and behold, the Lord’s glory stood there, like the vision and like the glory I had seen by the River Chebar; and I fall upon my face.
verses.display_text: I rose and went out to the plain, and behold, the Lord’s glory stood there, like the vision and like the glory I had seen by the River Chebar; and I fall upon my face.

verses.text: A spirit came upon me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said to me, “Go, be shut inside your house.
verses.display_text: A spirit came upon me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said to me, “Go, be shut inside your house.

verses.text: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been placed upon you, and they will bind you with them; you certainly will not go out from among them.
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been placed upon you, and they will bind you with them; you certainly will not go out from among them.

verses.text: I will bind your tongue, and you will become mute; you will not be a man rebuking them, for it is an embittering house.
verses.display_text: I will bind your tongue, and you will become mute; you will not be a man rebuking them, for it is an embittering house.

verses.text: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Let the one who hears hear, and let the one who disobeys disobey,’ for it is an embittering house.”
verses.display_text: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Let the one who hears hear, and let the one who disobeys disobey,’ for it is an embittering house.”

verses.text: “And you, son of man, take a brick, set it before your face, and draw upon it a city—Jerusalem;
verses.display_text: “And you, son of man, take a brick, set it before your face, and draw upon it a city—Jerusalem;

verses.text: lay siege to it, build forward defenses against it, throw up a palisade against it, set camps against it, and arrange missile positions all around.
verses.display_text: lay siege to it, build forward defenses against it, throw up a palisade against it, set camps against it, and arrange missile positions all around.

verses.text: Take an iron pan and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Prepare your face against it; it will be besieged, and you will besiege it. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.
verses.display_text: Take an iron pan and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Prepare your face against it; it will be besieged, and you will besiege it. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.

verses.text: Lie on your left side and place the injustices of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of days—one hundred fifty—that you lie upon it; bear their injustices.
verses.display_text: Lie on your left side and place the injustices of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of days—one hundred fifty—that you lie upon it; bear their injustices.

verses.text: I have assigned you their two injustices as a number of days, one hundred ninety days; bear the injustices of the house of Israel
verses.display_text: I have assigned you their two injustices as a number of days, one hundred ninety days; bear the injustices of the house of Israel

verses.text: and complete all these things. Lie on your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Judah forty days. I have appointed you a day for a year.
verses.display_text: and complete all these things. Lie on your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Judah forty days. I have appointed you a day for a year.

verses.text: Prepare your face against Jerusalem’s siege, strengthen your arm, and prophesy against it.
verses.display_text: Prepare your face against Jerusalem’s siege, strengthen your arm, and prophesy against it.

verses.text: Behold, I have placed bonds upon you; do not turn from side to side until the days of your confinement are completed.
verses.display_text: Behold, I have placed bonds upon you; do not turn from side to side until the days of your confinement are completed.

verses.text: Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt; put them in one earthen vessel and make loaves from them for yourself. According to the number of days you sleep on your side, you will eat them one hundred ninety days.
verses.display_text: Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt; put them in one earthen vessel and make loaves from them for yourself. According to the number of days you sleep on your side, you will eat them one hundred ninety days.

verses.text: The food you are to eat will be weighed out: twenty shekels a day; eat it from time to time.
verses.display_text: The food you are to eat will be weighed out: twenty shekels a day; eat it from time to time.

verses.text: Drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin; drink it from time to time.
verses.display_text: Drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin; drink it from time to time.

verses.text: Eat it as a barley cake baked in embers; bake it in pellets of human dung before their eyes,
verses.display_text: Eat it as a barley cake baked in embers; bake it in pellets of human dung before their eyes,

verses.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: So the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.’”
verses.display_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: So the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.’”

verses.text: I said, “By no means, Lord, God of Israel! Behold, my life has not been defiled with uncleanness. From my birth until now I have eaten neither what died of itself nor what a wild animal killed, nor has any stale meat entered my mouth.”
verses.display_text: I said, “By no means, Lord, God of Israel! Behold, my life has not been defiled with uncleanness. From my birth until now I have eaten neither what died of itself nor what a wild animal killed, nor has any stale meat entered my mouth.”

verses.text: He said to me, “Behold, I have given you cattle dung instead of human dung; prepare your loaves over it.”
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Behold, I have given you cattle dung instead of human dung; prepare your loaves over it.”

verses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am breaking the support of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight and in need, and drink water by measure and in devastation,
verses.display_text: He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am breaking the support of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight and in need, and drink water by measure and in devastation,

verses.text: so that they become needy for bread and water. A man and his brother will disappear, and they will waste away in their injustices.
verses.display_text: so that they become needy for bread and water. A man and his brother will disappear, and they will waste away in their injustices.

verses.text: “And you, son of man, take a sword sharper than a barber’s razor. Obtain it for yourself and pass it over your head and your beard. Take a balance with weights and divide the hairs;
verses.display_text: “And you, son of man, take a sword sharper than a barber’s razor. Obtain it for yourself and pass it over your head and your beard. Take a balance with weights and divide the hairs;

verses.text: burn a quarter with fire inside the city when the days of siege are complete. Take a quarter and burn it up in its midst; cut down a quarter with the sword around it, and scatter a quarter to the wind. I will draw a sword after them.
verses.display_text: burn a quarter with fire inside the city when the days of siege are complete. Take a quarter and burn it up in its midst; cut down a quarter with the sword around it, and scatter a quarter to the wind. I will draw a sword after them.

verses.text: Take a few of them in number and gather them into your cloak.
verses.display_text: Take a few of them in number and gather them into your cloak.

verses.text: Take some of these again, cast them into the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it fire will go out. And you will say to the entire house of Israel,
verses.display_text: Take some of these again, cast them into the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it fire will go out. And you will say to the entire house of Israel,

verses.text: ‘Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem. I have placed her amid the nations, and the lands around her.
verses.display_text: ‘Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem. I have placed her amid the nations, and the lands around her.

verses.text: And you will speak My ordinances to the lawless one among the nations, and My laws among the lands around her; for they rejected My ordinances and did not walk in My laws.
verses.display_text: And you will speak My ordinances to the lawless one among the nations, and My laws among the lands around her; for they rejected My ordinances and did not walk in My laws.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your impulse comes from the nations around you, and you have not walked in My laws or performed My ordinances—nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you—
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your impulse comes from the nations around you, and you have not walked in My laws or performed My ordinances—nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you—

verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst before the nations,
verses.display_text: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst before the nations,

verses.text: and I will do among you what I have not done and the like of which I will not do again, according to all your abominations.
verses.display_text: and I will do among you what I have not done and the like of which I will not do again, according to all your abominations.

verses.text: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.
verses.display_text: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.

verses.text: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you defiled My holy places with all your abominations, I too will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no mercy.
verses.display_text: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you defiled My holy places with all your abominations, I too will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no mercy.

verses.text: A quarter of you will be consumed by death; a quarter of you will perish by famine within you; a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind; and a quarter of you will fall by the sword around you, and I will draw a sword after them.
verses.display_text: A quarter of you will be consumed by death; a quarter of you will perish by famine within you; a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind; and a quarter of you will fall by the sword around you, and I will draw a sword after them.

verses.text: My wrath and My anger against them will be completed, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My jealousy when I complete My anger against them.
verses.display_text: My wrath and My anger against them will be completed, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My jealousy when I complete My anger against them.

verses.text: I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before every passerby;
verses.display_text: I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before every passerby;

verses.text: you will be mourned and ravaged among the nations around you when I execute judgments against you in the vengeance of My wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.display_text: you will be mourned and ravaged among the nations around you when I execute judgments against you in the vengeance of My wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.

verses.text: When I send My arrows of famine against them, they will bring exhaustion, and I will break your support of bread.
verses.display_text: When I send My arrows of famine against them, they will bring exhaustion, and I will break your support of bread.

verses.text: I will send famine and harmful wild animals against you, and I will punish you. Death and blood will pass over you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
verses.display_text: I will send famine and harmful wild animals against you, and I will punish you. Death and blood will pass over you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.’”

verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and the whole house of Israel have been brought to an end. To them Jerusalem’s inhabitants said, ‘Keep far from the Lord; the land has been given to us as an inheritance.’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and the whole house of Israel have been brought to an end. To them Jerusalem’s inhabitants said, ‘Keep far from the Lord; the land has been given to us as an inheritance.’

verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will thrust them away into the nations and scatter them through all the earth, and I will be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they may enter.’
verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will thrust them away into the nations and scatter them through all the earth, and I will be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they may enter.’

verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will receive them from the nations and gather them from the countries where I scattered them, and I will give them the land of Israel.
verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will receive them from the nations and gather them from the countries where I scattered them, and I will give them the land of Israel.

verses.text: They will enter there and remove all her abominations and all her lawlessness from her.
verses.display_text: They will enter there and remove all her abominations and all her lawlessness from her.

verses.text: I will give them another heart and put a new spirit within them. I will tear the stone heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.display_text: I will give them another heart and put a new spirit within them. I will tear the stone heart from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,

verses.text: so that they may walk in My commands, keep My ordinances and carry them out. They will be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.display_text: so that they may walk in My commands, keep My ordinances and carry them out. They will be My people, and I will be their God.

verses.text: As their heart went toward the heart of their abominations and their lawlessness, I have brought their ways upon their heads, says the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: As their heart went toward the heart of their abominations and their lawlessness, I have brought their ways upon their heads, says the Lord.’”

verses.text: The cherubim raised their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was upon them, above them.
verses.display_text: The cherubim raised their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was upon them, above them.

verses.text: The Lord’s glory rose from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain opposite the city.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s glory rose from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain opposite the city.

verses.text: A spirit lifted me and brought me into the Chaldeans’ land, to the captives, in a vision by God’s spirit. I rose out of the vision I had seen,
verses.display_text: A spirit lifted me and brought me into the Chaldeans’ land, to the captives, in a vision by God’s spirit. I rose out of the vision I had seen,

verses.text: and I spoke to the captives all the Lord’s words that He had shown me.
verses.display_text: and I spoke to the captives all the Lord’s words that He had shown me.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices. They have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because they are an embittering house.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices. They have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because they are an embittering house.

verses.text: And you, son of man, get your belongings ready for captivity by day before them. You will be taken captive from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because they are an embittering house.
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, get your belongings ready for captivity by day before them. You will be taken captive from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because they are an embittering house.

verses.text: You will bring your belongings out like belongings for captivity by day before their eyes, and you yourself will go out in the evening as a captive goes out.
verses.display_text: You will bring your belongings out like belongings for captivity by day before their eyes, and you yourself will go out in the evening as a captive goes out.

verses.text: Before them, dig for yourself through the wall, and you will pass out through it.
verses.display_text: Before them, dig for yourself through the wall, and you will pass out through it.

verses.text: Before them you will be lifted upon shoulders and go out concealed. Cover your face, and you certainly will not see the land, for I have made you a portent to the house of Israel.”
verses.display_text: Before them you will be lifted upon shoulders and go out concealed. Cover your face, and you certainly will not see the land, for I have made you a portent to the house of Israel.”

verses.text: I did so according to all that He commanded me. I brought belongings out like belongings for captivity by day; in the evening I dug through the wall for myself and went out concealed. I was lifted upon shoulders before them.
verses.display_text: I did so according to all that He commanded me. I brought belongings out like belongings for captivity by day; in the evening I dug through the wall for myself and went out concealed. I was lifted upon shoulders before them.

verses.text: In the morning the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the morning the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the embittering house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the embittering house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

verses.text: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: The ruler and the leader in Jerusalem and in the whole house of Israel, who are among them—’
verses.display_text: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: The ruler and the leader in Jerusalem and in the whole house of Israel, who are among them—’

verses.text: Say, ‘I perform portents in her midst. As I have done, so it will be for them; in deportation and captivity they will go.’
verses.display_text: Say, ‘I perform portents in her midst. As I have done, so it will be for them; in deportation and captivity they will go.’

verses.text: All those around him, his helpers and all who support him, I will scatter to every wind; I will draw a sword after them.
verses.display_text: All those around him, his helpers and all who support him, I will scatter to every wind; I will draw a sword after them.

verses.text: They will know that I am the Lord when I scatter them among the nations, and I will disperse them among the countries.
verses.display_text: They will know that I am the Lord when I scatter them among the nations, and I will disperse them among the countries.

verses.text: I will spare a few men among them from sword, famine and death, so that they may recount all their lawlessness among the nations where they entered, and they will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: I will spare a few men among them from sword, famine and death, so that they may recount all their lawlessness among the nations where they entered, and they will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, eat your bread with pain, and drink your water with torment and distress,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, eat your bread with pain, and drink your water with torment and distress,

verses.text: and say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem’s inhabitants upon Israel’s land: They will eat their bread with want and drink their water with devastation, so that the land may be destroyed with its fullness, for all who dwell in it are in impiety.
verses.display_text: and say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem’s inhabitants upon Israel’s land: They will eat their bread with want and drink their water with devastation, so that the land may be destroyed with its fullness, for all who dwell in it are in impiety.

verses.display_text: Their inhabited cities will be made desolate, and the land will be laid waste. You will recognize that I am the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have concerning Israel’s land, saying, ‘The days are far off; vision has perished’?
verses.display_text: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have concerning Israel’s land, saying, ‘The days are far off; vision has perished’?

verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will turn back this proverb, and the house of Israel certainly will no longer say this proverb.’ For you will speak to them: ‘The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision,
verses.display_text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: I will turn back this proverb, and the house of Israel certainly will no longer say this proverb.’ For you will speak to them: ‘The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision,

verses.text: because there will no longer be any false vision or anyone divining pleasing things among the sons of Israel,
verses.display_text: because there will no longer be any false vision or anyone divining pleasing things among the sons of Israel,

verses.text: because I, the Lord, will speak My words; I will speak and act, and I certainly will delay no longer. For in your days, embittering house, I will speak a word and act, says the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: because I, the Lord, will speak My words; I will speak and act, and I certainly will delay no longer. For in your days, embittering house, I will speak a word and act, says the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, behold, the embittering house of Israel keeps saying, ‘The vision this man sees is for many days ahead; this man prophesies of times far ahead.’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, behold, the embittering house of Israel keeps saying, ‘The vision this man sees is for many days ahead; this man prophesies of times far ahead.’

verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: None of My words that I may speak will be prolonged any longer. I will speak and act, says the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: None of My words that I may speak will be prolonged any longer. I will speak and act, says the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s prophets; you will prophesy and say to them, ‘Hear the Lord’s word!
verses.display_text: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s prophets; you will prophesy and say to them, ‘Hear the Lord’s word!

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart and see nothing at all!
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart and see nothing at all!

verses.text: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses.
verses.display_text: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses.

verses.text: They did not stand in a firm position, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those saying, ‘On the Lord’s day,’ did not rise.
verses.display_text: They did not stand in a firm position, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those saying, ‘On the Lord’s day,’ did not rise.

verses.text: They see false things and divine vain things, those who say, ‘The Lord says,’ although the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.
verses.display_text: They see false things and divine vain things, those who say, ‘The Lord says,’ although the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.

verses.text: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?
verses.display_text: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?

verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord,
verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord,

verses.text: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see false things and utter vain things. They will not belong to My people’s instruction, nor be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter Israel’s land. They will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see false things and utter vain things. They will not belong to My people’s instruction, nor be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter Israel’s land. They will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Because they misled My people, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there was no peace, and this one builds a wall, and they coat it—if it is going to fall,
verses.display_text: Because they misled My people, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there was no peace, and this one builds a wall, and they coat it—if it is going to fall,

verses.text: say to those coating it, ‘It will fall.’ There will be a flooding downpour, and I will put stones for hurling into their bonds, and they will fall; there will be an upending wind, and it will be split.
verses.display_text: say to those coating it, ‘It will fall.’ There will be a flooding downpour, and I will put stones for hurling into their bonds, and they will fall; there will be an upending wind, and it will be split.

verses.text: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will they not say to you, ‘Where is your coating with which you coated it?’
verses.display_text: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will they not say to you, ‘Where is your coating with which you coated it?’

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will unleash an upending blast with wrath; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and I will bring the projectile stones in wrath for complete destruction,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will unleash an upending blast with wrath; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and I will bring the projectile stones in wrath for complete destruction,

verses.text: and I will tear down the wall you coated, and it will fall. I will lay it upon the ground; its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: and I will tear down the wall you coated, and it will fall. I will lay it upon the ground; its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: I will complete My wrath upon the wall and those coating it, and it will fall. I said to you, ‘There is no wall, nor those coating it—
verses.display_text: I will complete My wrath upon the wall and those coating it, and it will fall. I said to you, ‘There is no wall, nor those coating it—

verses.text: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and see peace for her, when there is no peace,’ says the Lord.’
verses.display_text: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and see peace for her, when there is no peace,’ says the Lord.’

verses.text: And you, son of man, set your face firmly against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, set your face firmly against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,

verses.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women sewing cushions upon every elbow of an arm and making coverings upon every head of every age, to distort lives! The lives of My people were distorted, and they were preserving lives.
verses.display_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women sewing cushions upon every elbow of an arm and making coverings upon every head of every age, to distort lives! The lives of My people were distorted, and they were preserving lives.

verses.text: They were profaning Me among My people for a handful of barley and scraps of bread, putting to death lives that ought not die and preserving lives that ought not live, as you uttered things to a people listening to vain pronouncements.
verses.display_text: They were profaning Me among My people for a handful of barley and scraps of bread, putting to death lives that ought not die and preserving lives that ought not live, as you uttered things to a people listening to vain pronouncements.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against your cushions, on which you entangle lives. I will tear them from your arms and send the lives out—their lives that you twist away—into dispersion.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against your cushions, on which you entangle lives. I will tear them from your arms and send the lives out—their lives that you twist away—into dispersion.

verses.text: I will tear your coverings and rescue My people from your hand. They will no longer be in your hands for entanglement, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will tear your coverings and rescue My people from your hand. They will no longer be in your hands for entanglement, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Because you distorted the righteous person’s heart unjustly, though I was not distorting him, and strengthened the lawless person’s hands so that he does not turn at all from his evil way and live,
verses.display_text: Because you distorted the righteous person’s heart unjustly, though I was not distorting him, and strengthened the lawless person’s hands so that he does not turn at all from his evil way and live,

verses.text: therefore you certainly will no longer see false things or divine divinations. I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: therefore you certainly will no longer see false things or divine divinations. I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”

verses.text: Men from Israel’s elders came to me and sat before me.
verses.display_text: Men from Israel’s elders came to me and sat before me.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their faces. Shall I indeed answer them?
verses.display_text: “Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their faces. Shall I indeed answer them?

verses.text: Therefore speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Anyone of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet—I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,
verses.display_text: Therefore speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Anyone of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet—I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,

verses.text: so that it may turn the house of Israel aside in accordance with their hearts, alienated from Me through their reflections.’
verses.display_text: so that it may turn the house of Israel aside in accordance with their hearts, alienated from Me through their reflections.’

verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Turn back and turn away from your practices and all your impieties, and turn your faces.
verses.display_text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Turn back and turn away from your practices and all your impieties, and turn your faces.

verses.text: For anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners living among Israel who becomes alienated from Me, sets his reflections upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet to question him concerning Me—I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.
verses.display_text: For anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners living among Israel who becomes alienated from Me, sets his reflections upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet to question him concerning Me—I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.

verses.text: I will set My face firmly against that person, make him a wilderness and a devastation, and remove him from the midst of My people. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will set My face firmly against that person, make him a wilderness and a devastation, and remove him from the midst of My people. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: If the prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray. I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.display_text: If the prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray. I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.

verses.text: They will receive their injustice; according to the inquirer’s offense and according to the offense, it will likewise be for the prophet,

verses.text: so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from Me or be defiled by any of their transgressions. They will be My people, and I will be their God, says the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from Me or be defiled by any of their transgressions. They will be My people, and I will be their God, says the Lord.’”

verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by committing a transgression, and I stretch My hand against it, shatter its support of bread, send famine upon it, and remove human and livestock from it,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by committing a transgression, and I stretch My hand against it, shatter its support of bread, send famine upon it, and remove human and livestock from it,

verses.display_text: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were within it, they themselves would be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.

verses.display_text: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters would be saved; only they themselves would be saved, and the land would be destroyed.

verses.text: Or even if I bring a sword upon that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through the land,’ and remove human and livestock from it,

verses.display_text: and these three men were within it, as I live, says the Lord, they certainly would not rescue sons or daughters; they alone would be saved.

verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “And you, son of man, what could vinewood be among all the branch wood found among the forest trees?
verses.display_text: “And you, son of man, what could vinewood be among all the branch wood found among the forest trees?

verses.display_text: It has only been given to the fire to be consumed. Fire consumes its yearly prunings, and it is utterly spent. Surely it will not be useful for work?

verses.display_text: Even when it is whole, it will not serve for work. How much less if fire consumes it completely—will it still serve for work?

verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: As with the vinewood among the forest trees, which I have given to the fire to be consumed, so I have given Jerusalem’s inhabitants.

verses.text: “Son of man, solemnly testify to Jerusalem about her lawlessness,

verses.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

verses.display_text: You were adorned with gold and silver; your coverings were fine linen, hair-woven and patterned. You ate fine flour, oil and honey, and became very beautiful.

verses.display_text: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was made complete in splendor, in the loveliness I placed upon you, says the Lord.

verses.text: You trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your fame. You poured out your prostitution upon every passerby—which will not be.
verses.display_text: You trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your fame. You poured out your prostitution upon every passerby—which will not be.

verses.display_text: You took some of your garments, made sewn idols for yourself and prostituted yourself upon them. You certainly will not enter, nor will it come to be.

verses.display_text: You took your patterned clothing and clothed them; you set My oil and My incense before them.

verses.text: My loaves that I gave you—fine flour, oil and honey with which I fed you—you set before them as a fragrant aroma. So it happened, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: My loaves that I gave you—fine flour, oil and honey with which I fed you—you set before them as a fragrant aroma. So it happened, says the Lord.

verses.display_text: you built yourself a prostitution chamber and made yourself a display place in every broad street,

verses.display_text: and at the head of every road you built your brothels, ruined your beauty, spread your legs to every passerby, and multiplied your prostitution.

verses.display_text: You prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors great in flesh, and prostituted yourself in many ways to anger Me.

verses.text: But if I stretch My hand against you, I will remove your ordinances and hand you over to the desires of those who hate you, daughters of foreigners who turn you aside from your way in which you acted impiously.

verses.display_text: What shall I do to your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these things, the works of a prostitute? And you prostituted yourself threefold

verses.display_text: among your daughters. You built your brothel at every road head and made your platform in every broad street, and became like a prostitute gathering payments.

verses.display_text: she kept giving payments to all who prostituted her. You too gave payments to all your lovers and loaded them up to come to you from all around in your prostitution.

verses.display_text: Therefore, prostitute, hear the Lord’s word!

verses.display_text: I will exact retribution upon you with the retribution of an adulteress and a woman shedding blood, and place you in blood of wrath and jealousy.

verses.display_text: You are the daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and the sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

verses.display_text: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, dwelling at your left; your sister younger than you, dwelling at your right, is Sodom and her daughters.

verses.display_text: Samaria did not sin half your sins. You multiplied your lawlessness beyond theirs and justified your sisters by all the lawlessness you committed.

verses.display_text: You too, receive your torment, in which you corrupted your sisters by your sins, in which you acted more lawlessly than they and justified them above yourself. You too, be ashamed and take your dishonor, in that you justified your sisters.

verses.display_text: so that you may receive your torment and be dishonored for all you did in provoking Me.

verses.display_text: before your evils were revealed—as now you are a reproach of Syria’s daughters and all around her, daughters of foreigners who surround you all around?

verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: I will deal with you as you have done, as you dishonored these things by transgressing My covenant.

verses.display_text: I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your infancy and raise up for you an eternal covenant.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, tell a story and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, tell a story and speak a parable to the house of Israel,

verses.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, with great wings and a broad span, full of talons, which has authority to enter Lebanon, took the cedar’s choice parts;
verses.display_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, with great wings and a broad span, full of talons, which has authority to enter Lebanon, took the cedar’s choice parts;

verses.display_text: he nipped off the tips of its tender growth, carried them to the land of Canaan, and set them in a fortified city.

verses.display_text: He took some of the land’s seed and put it in the plain, a plant beside abundant water; he appointed it to be watched over.

verses.display_text: It sprouted and became a weak vine, small in size so that it might appear. Its branches were upon it and its roots beneath it. It became a vine, produced offshoots and extended its climbing growth.

verses.display_text: There was another great eagle, with great wings and many talons. Behold, this vine was intertwined toward him, its roots toward him; it sent its branches to him to water it together with the clod of its planting.

verses.display_text: It grows fat in a good plain beside abundant water, to produce shoots, bear fruit and become a great vine.

verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and its fruit rot, and all its early shoots dry up? No great arm or numerous people will be needed to pull it from its roots.
verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and its fruit rot, and all its early shoots dry up? No great arm or numerous people will be needed to pull it from its roots.

verses.display_text: Behold, it grows fat—surely it will not prosper? Will it not dry up completely as soon as the scorching wind touches it? It will dry up together with the clod of its growth.’”

verses.display_text: One of her cubs sprang away; he became a lion, learned to seize prey, and ate human beings.
